thinking_text:
**Analyzing image details**

I'm reflecting on the +Y/-Y images, noting a green item that's evident in both transparencies. The current wheel seems positioned near one end. I’m wondering if "bottom" could refer to the lower edge of the image, and in engineering, that aligns with the underside. There’s a question about word categories and duplicates—do exact words get repeated? It appears that the phrasing suggests some replicability in arrays, which is interesting to consider.

request.raw_text: Add a sliding switch on the bottom to provide a convenient on and off function

areas_to_change.action: Add a low-profile sliding switch assembly and its required travel opening or recess.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The broad bottom face of the enclosure, opposite the upper face containing the existing green control.
areas_to_change.location: On an accessible region of the underside, preferably near the longitudinal centerline and clear of the perimeter walls.
areas_to_change.description: Modify a localized area of the bottom panel with a short slot or recessed pocket and install a projecting slider actuator that can be moved between two stable positions.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Upper enclosure and existing green control
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve their geometry, position, clearances, and operation.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Curved sidewalls, end caps, and external perimeter
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Retain the existing exterior profile and edge transitions without changing the overall envelope.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Bottom panel outside the switch installation area
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep the existing surface, wall thickness, and enclosure interfaces unchanged.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: A compact rectangular or pill-shaped slider will be integrated into a localized slot or recess in the underside of the enclosure.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The new control will provide a convenient manual power on/off function.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The actuator will translate along a short linear path and remain in either the ON or OFF position until deliberately moved.

ambiguities.description: The exact switch position and sliding direction on the bottom are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Place it near the centerline and slide it along the enclosure length.
Place it near an underside edge for easier access and slide it across the enclosure width.

ambiguities.description: No switch dimensions, travel distance, recess depth, or mounting method are provided.
candidate_interpretations: Use a flush-mounted miniature two-position slide switch.
Use a recessed switch with a slightly raised actuator for finger access.

ambiguities.description: The request does not define whether the edit includes only external switch geometry or a complete functional internal mechanism.
candidate_interpretations: Add the external actuator and enclosure opening only.
Add the actuator, switch body, mounting features, and internal clearance.
